info.name: Polymath API Service CANBus Health Check API
Get the version of the Polymath system

items.docs: Returns the current Polymath Synapse and polymath_core commit SHAs.
Returns a basic self health status response. This endpoint is used to verify that the Polymath Synapse API is running and responsive.

info.name: Get the UUID of the Polymath system

items.docs: Returns the device UUID derived from its MAC address. Deprecated; use `/health`.
